items.title: Tesla’s Cybercab Officially Launches Today. It’s Already Under Investigation
items.summary: The US government is investigating whether the Cybercab, which lacks a steering wheel and pedals, meets vehicle safety standards.

items.title: Cyclospora outbreaks expose a U.S. food safety system that’s been crumbling for decades—and Musk’s DOGE cuts are ‘only going to make that worse’
items.summary: “None of this is efficiency,” one food safety expert said of DOGE’s government personnel and research cuts. "This is all whatever the opposite of efficiency is.”
items.titleZh: 环孢菌爆发暴露了几十年来一直在崩溃的美国食品安全体系——马斯克的DOGE削减“只会让情况变得更糟”
items.summaryZh: 一位食品安全专家在谈到DOGE的政府人员和研究削减时说：“这些都不是效率。”。“这就是效率的反面。”

items.title: Robotaxis enter their villain era
items.summary: It's Bullitt meets Christine meets Waymo. A new short film imagines a San Francisco car chase where the other driver isn't human - and the car may be trying to kill you. That a robotaxi can now be cast as the villain with almost no explanation says something …
items.titleZh: 机器人出租车进入反派时代
items.summaryZh: 这是布利特遇见克里斯汀遇见Waymo。一部新的短片想象了一场旧金山的汽车追逐，其中另一个司机不是人——汽车可能试图杀死你。机器人出租车现在可以在几乎没有任何解释的情况下扮演反派角色，这说明了一些事情…

items.title: ‘A Storm of Cybercabs’: Musk launches steering-wheel-free taxis even as 70% of Americans say they’re uncomfortable with driverless cars
items.summary: Tesla’s gold-colored taxis have no steering wheels or brake pedals—and give passengers no way to take control in an emergency.

items.summaryZh: 特斯拉的金色出租车没有方向盘或刹车踏板，乘客在紧急情况下无法控制。
